question: Three point charges $q_1 = +2\,\mu\text{C}$, $q_2 = -1\,\mu\text{C}$ and $q_3 = -3\,\mu\text{C}$ are placed in air such that $r_{12} = 0.20\text{ m}$, $r_{23} = 0.30\text{ m}$ and $r_{13} = 0.50\text{ m}$. Calculate the electrostatic potential energy of the system. If $q_3$ is removed to infinity while $q_1$ and $q_2$ are kept fixed, find the change in potential energy of the remaining system. Take $\frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0} = 9 \times 10^9\text{ N m}^2\text{ C}^{-2}$.
